I mean… yes, if it’s actually clear proof, I can accept an ordinary explanation for one piece of it. I’m not trying to make every little thing into something sinister. I’m not sure how to answer that exactly. I mean, I think about him, of course. He was my father, so it’s not like he just disappears from my mind because time has passed. ========== OUTPUT [patient] ==========
I’m not sure… I mean, if you mean do I sometimes feel like it can’t be real, then maybe emotionally, yes, there are moments where it still feels strange to say it out loud. But I don’t think I’m confused about the fact of it.
